name: Uehara Kitae
source:
Kitae is the world's most foremost magician who helped creates the barriers against vampires.
The barrier is so strong that it not only repels vampires, it destroys them if they try to force their way through.
She established an academy where she fosters potential magicians, set up a barrier, and serves as a board member.

Although she is growing older, her beauty and body have not deteriorated.
Kitae's grandfather acted as the ambassador for the vampire's pact with the humans.
Since childhood, she has been close friends with Cara.
